description: This file is a shell script that sets up platform-specific upgrade procedures for a certain board configuration, particularly for a board called 'imx7d-pico-pi'. It defines functions to enable image metadata checking, check the image, perform upgrades, copy configurations, and pre-upgrade steps, all conditioned on the board type.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata checking for specific board configurations.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is supported on the current board, returns 0 if supported.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure for the specific board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration for the specific board.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade steps for the specific board.
